in_sanskrit.name: प्रमिला
in_sanskrit.meaning: प्राग्ज्योतिष् (प्रा) मिलिता (मिल) अस्मिन् स्थाने अस्ति (ला) । प्राग्ज्योतिष् ज्योतिर्वहनी (प्रा) अपि तत् स्थानम् अपगमनतो द्रक्ष्यति (मिल) । प्राग्ज्योतिष् वहनी अपि तत् स्थानम् प्राप्य (ला) । अतो प्रमिला । प्राग्ज्योतिष् ज्योतिर्वहनी प्राप्य ।
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The one who has reached before the light (knowledge, truth) or the one who has obtained the light (knowledge, truth) earlier. Pragjyotis (light-giver) will also see that place (or come to that place) and will also reach that place.

data.cultural_impact: The name Pramila is of Sanskrit origin and is composed of two words - 'Pra' and 'Mila'. 'Pra' means 'first' or 'foremost' and 'Mila' means 'lotus'. In Hindu culture, the lotus is a symbol of purity, beauty, and divine spiritual growth. The name Pramila is said to echo the beauty and grace of a lotus blooming in the heart of the person. This name holds a special place in the cultural traditions of India, especially in the north, where it is believed that naming newborns with spiritual and meaningful names instills divine blessings in their lives.
data.spiritual_significance: The number one is considered to be the most spiritual number in Hinduism, representing the oneness or unity of the universe. The name Pramila is significant because it contains the word 'Pra', which symbolizes the first or the foremost, emphasizing that the individual carrying the name is the embodiment of purity, grace, and divine spiritual growth, just like the lotus that blooms first and gives the pond its best reflection. The term 'Mila', symbolizing the lotus, represents the individual's beautiful inner nature that continues to bloom and radiate its pure and divine essence. Ultimately, the name Pramila serves as a reminder of one's innate spiritual potential and calls upon the individual to nurture and cultivate their inner spiritual garden, allowing it to bloom and fill their lives with beauty, grace, and lasting happiness.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Pramila: Radiance of pure devotion. A beacon of inner light, shining with selfless love and dedication.
